resources.string: Counts Reels and Shorts and tracks scrolling time, on-device only.

ScrollLess uses the accessibility service to notice when a new Instagram Reel or YouTube Short appears on screen, count it, and measure how long you spend scrolling. It only reads the Instagram and YouTube windows, stores everything in a local database on this device, and never sends your activity anywhere.
